mapper.sql: id, project_id, participant_id, role, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, delflag
mapper.select: SELECT pd.id, pd.project_id, pd.participant_id, pd.role, pd.tenant_id, pd.created_at, pd.updated_at, pd.created_by, pd.updated_by, pd.delflag, u.username as participant_username, u.nickname as participant_name, u.email as participant_email, u.mobile as participant_phone, d.name as department_name FROM project_detail pd LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON pd.participant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE pd.project_id = #{projectId} AND pd.delflag = 0 AND (u.enabled = 1 OR u.enabled IS NULL) ORDER BY pd.created_at ASC

SELECT pd.id, pd.project_id, pd.participant_id, pd.role, pd.tenant_id, pd.created_at, pd.updated_at, pd.created_by, pd.updated_by, pd.delflag FROM project_detail pd WHERE pd.participant_id = #{participantId} AND pd.delflag = 0 ORDER BY pd.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pd.participant_id) FROM project_detail pd WHERE pd.project_id = #{projectId} AND pd.delflag = 0
